title: pi-command-guard configuration
description: Rule overrides merged over the 22 built-in command-guard rules. Layers, lowest precedence first: <agent-dir>/command-guard/rules.json, .pi/command-guard/rules.json, extensions/rules.json.

$schema.description: Pointer to this schema for editor validation.

enabled.description: Master switch. When false the guard lets every command through.

addRules.description: Extra rules appended after the built-ins.

removeRules.description: Rule ids to drop. Legacy positional ids (default-0 … default-21) are still accepted.

updateRules.description: Patches applied to existing rules by id.

id.description: Stable id. If omitted the guard assigns custom-N.

pattern.description: Regex source, or a /source/flags literal. A pattern that fails to compile never matches.

except.description: Negative context: if any of these match, the rule does not fire.

command.description: Command name matched after unwrapping sudo/env/time wrappers and skipping NAME=value assignments.

flagsAllOf.description: Every listed flag must be present.

flagsAnyOf.description: At least one listed flag must be present.

argAnyOf.description: At least one argument must match (regex source).
